DataPropertyAssertion.Literal: Cases found by differential fuzzing of the completion graph caching that are not caching criteria: classifications that did not terminate because of the at-most merging (now regression guards) and a wrong subsumption. Expected taxonomies are HermiT's.

Regression guard: the classification of fuzz seed 611 without completion graph caching and with delayed caching reactivation terminates and matches HermiT. It used to loop in the at-most merging because the set of distinct nodes kept the id of a node that was merged away.
Classification of fuzz seed 611 in the configurations that terminate (about 0.15 s); guards that the HermiT taxonomy is produced. This test runs without a configuration file.

This test runs without a configuration file.

Classification of fuzz seed 3016 with completion graph caching: does not terminate (100 percent CPU, constant memory; more than 300 s). Without completion graph caching it takes about 0.14 s and matches HermiT.

Classification of fuzz seed 3122: does not terminate in some runs, with and without completion graph caching; a long run reached 16.5 GB after 101 s at 100 percent CPU, so the memory grows. Expected: the HermiT taxonomy.

Classification of fuzz seed 2042 with completion graph caching: did not finish within 10 s in the campaign; a long run reached 23.8 GB and was killed by the OOM killer after 131 s, and the no-cache classification also grows (12.6 GB in 50 s). Expected: the HermiT taxonomy.

Classification of fuzz seed 3310 with completion graph caching: did not finish within 10 s in the campaign; a three-minute run stayed at 100 percent CPU with constant memory. Expected: the HermiT taxonomy, which the no-cache configuration produces.
Classification of fuzz seed 3241: the reasoner segfaults with and without completion graph caching (CIndividualIdentifier::getIndividualID from the backend-cache merging data of a nominal node).

Classification of fuzz seed 3344 with completion graph caching: the reasoner segfaults (same backend-cache initialisation path as seed 3241); without completion graph caching the HermiT taxonomy is produced.

Classification of the reduced fuzz seed 3397, repeated: three of five runs match HermiT, two add C0 below T1, which does not hold.

Consistency of fuzz seed 2167: Konclude answers consistent, but the ontology is inconsistent (a0 is in C1 and, through C2 = {a0}, the r0-predecessor in C0 = {a2} and C0 below all r0.C3, also in C3; C1 is disjoint with C3). HermiT answers inconsistent. This is a wrong consistency answer, not a caching difference.
Classification of fuzz seed 2245 without completion graph caching: does not finish (10 s campaign limit), while the default configuration finishes and matches HermiT (same shape as seed 2078).
